title: Thực hành viết lại câu với từ cho sẵn theo các cấu trúc trọng điểm
summary: Luyện dựng câu từ gợi ý với các cấu trúc trọng điểm thường gặp trong đề thi vào lớp 10 Hà Nội: because of, although, too/enough, used to, bị động, mệnh đề quan hệ, câu ước, so…that, look forward to.

theory.heading: Cấu trúc nguyên nhân, nhượng bộ, kết quả
points: because + mệnh đề / because of + cụm danh từ
although + mệnh đề (không thêm but) / despite + cụm danh từ
S + V + so + adj/adv + that + mệnh đề
S + be + too + adj + (for sb) + to V (không lặp tân ngữ ở cuối câu)

examples.en: Many people move to cities because of better job opportunities.
examples.vi: Nhiều người chuyển đến thành phố vì có cơ hội việc làm tốt hơn.

examples.en: The water is too dirty for us to swim in.
examples.vi: Nước quá bẩn để chúng tôi bơi.

theory.heading: Cấu trúc động từ trọng điểm
points: used to + V (thói quen quá khứ); look forward to + V-ing
It takes sb + time + to V; suggest that S (should) V
be (not) allowed to V; S + wish + S + V2 (ước ở hiện tại)

examples.en: I used to walk to school when I was a child.
examples.vi: Hồi nhỏ tôi thường đi bộ đến trường.

examples.en: Students are not allowed to use phones during the exam.
examples.vi: Học sinh không được dùng điện thoại trong giờ thi.

theory.heading: Bị động và mệnh đề quan hệ
points: Bị động quá khứ đơn: was/were + V3 (+ in + năm)
where thay cho nơi chốn khi mệnh đề sau đã đủ thành phần (I was born and grew up)
Mệnh đề quan hệ lược đại từ: the house (that) we live in – không lặp lại "it"

examples.en: The house we live in was built in 1990.
examples.vi: Ngôi nhà chúng tôi ở được xây năm 1990.

examples.en: Hanoi is the city where I was born and grew up.
examples.vi: Hà Nội là thành phố nơi tôi sinh ra và lớn lên.

tips: Nhận diện "cấu trúc khóa" trong dãy gợi ý (because, although, too, used, suggest, wish…) rồi nhớ lại công thức trước khi đọc phương án.
Phương án nhiễu thường sai đúng ở cấu trúc khóa: because + cụm danh từ, although … but, used to + V-ing, suggest sb to V.
Kiểm tra lần lượt: thì – hòa hợp chủ vị – giới từ đi kèm – mạo từ.
Câu có "in recent years", "ever" → nghĩ ngay tới hiện tại hoàn thành.

exercise_sets.title: Bài 1. Cấu trúc nguyên nhân, nhượng bộ, kết quả
exercise_sets.instructions: Choose the sentence (A, B, C or D) that is best made from the given cues.

questions.question: Many people / move / cities / better job opportunities.

options.A: Many people moves to cities because of better job opportunities.
options.B: Many people move to cities because better job opportunities.
options.C: Many people move cities because of better job opportunities.
options.D: Many people move to cities because of better job opportunities.

questions.explanation: "better job opportunities" là cụm danh từ → "because of"; "move to + nơi chốn"; "people" số nhiều → move.

questions.question: Although / traffic / heavy / we / arrive / on time / yesterday.

options.A: Although the traffic was heavy, but we arrived on time yesterday.
options.B: Although the traffic is heavy, we arrived on time yesterday.
options.C: Despite the traffic was heavy, we arrived on time yesterday.
options.D: Although the traffic was heavy, we arrived on time yesterday.

questions.explanation: "yesterday" → hai vế quá khứ; Although không đi với but; Despite không đi với mệnh đề.

questions.question: The water / too / dirty / us / swim / in.

options.A: The water is dirty enough for us to swim in.
options.B: The water is too dirty for us to swim in.
options.C: The water is too dirty for us to swim in it.
options.D: The water is too dirty that we can't swim in.

questions.explanation: too + adj + for sb + to V; không lặp tân ngữ "it" vì chủ ngữ "The water" đã là đối tượng của "swim in".

questions.question: She / speak / English / so / fluently / everyone / think / she / be / native speaker.

options.A: She speaks English such fluently that everyone thinks she is a native speaker.
options.B: She speaks English so fluently that everyone think she is a native speaker.
options.C: She speaks English so fluently that everyone thinks she is a native speaker.
options.D: She speaks English so fluent that everyone thinks she is a native speaker.

questions.explanation: so + trạng từ (fluently) + that; "everyone" chia số ít → thinks.

exercise_sets.title: Bài 2. Cấu trúc động từ trọng điểm
exercise_sets.instructions: Choose the sentence (A, B, C or D) that is best made from the given cues.

questions.question: I / used / walk / school / when / I / be / a child.

options.A: I used to walking to school when I was a child.
options.B: I was used to walk to school when I was a child.
options.C: I used to walk to school when I am a child.
options.D: I used to walk to school when I was a child.

questions.explanation: used to + V nguyên mẫu (thói quen quá khứ); mệnh đề "when" cũng ở quá khứ.

questions.question: My teacher / suggest / we / read / more English books.

options.A: My teacher suggested us to read more English books.
options.B: My teacher suggested we reading more English books.
options.C: My teacher suggested that we should read more English books.
options.D: My teacher suggest that we should read more English books.

questions.explanation: suggest that + S + (should) + V; không dùng "suggest sb to V"; chủ ngữ số ít nên không thể dùng "suggest" ở hiện tại đơn.

questions.question: It / take / my father / 30 minutes / drive / work / every day.

options.A: It takes my father 30 minutes to drive to work every day.
options.B: It takes my father 30 minutes driving to work every day.
options.C: It take my father 30 minutes to drive to work every day.
options.D: It takes my father 30 minutes to drive work every day.

questions.explanation: "every day" → hiện tại đơn, chủ ngữ "It" → takes; It takes sb + time + to V; "drive to work".

questions.question: I / wish / I / have / more time / my family.

options.A: I wish I had more time for my family.
options.B: I wish I having more time for my family.
options.C: I wish I have more time for my family.
options.D: I wish I will have more time for my family.

questions.explanation: Ước ở hiện tại: wish + S + V2 (had).

questions.question: Online learning / become / more and more / popular / recent years.

options.A: Online learning have become more and more popular in recent years.
options.B: Online learning has become more and more popular in recent years.
options.C: Online learning became more and more popular in recent years.
options.D: Online learning has become more and more popularly in recent years.

questions.explanation: "in recent years" → hiện tại hoàn thành; sau "become" dùng tính từ; chủ ngữ số ít → has.

questions.question: We / look forward / see / you / again / soon.

options.A: We look forward seeing you again soon.
options.B: We are looking forward to seeing you again soon.
options.C: We are looking forward for seeing you again soon.
options.D: We are looking forward to see you again soon.

questions.explanation: "look forward to + V-ing"; "to" là giới từ.

exercise_sets.title: Bài 3. Bị động, mệnh đề quan hệ, so sánh
exercise_sets.instructions: Choose the sentence (A, B, C or D) that is best made from the given cues.

questions.question: The house / we / live in / build / 1990.

options.A: The house we live in it was built in 1990.
options.B: The house we live in was built on 1990.
options.C: The house we live in built in 1990.
options.D: The house we live in was built in 1990.

questions.explanation: Ngôi nhà "được xây" → bị động quá khứ "was built"; không lặp "it"; năm dùng "in".

questions.question: Hanoi / city / where / I / be / born / and / grow up.

options.A: Hanoi is the city which I was born and grew up.
options.B: Hanoi is the city where I was born and grew up.
options.C: Hanoi is the city where I was born and grow up.
options.D: Hanoi is the city where I born and grew up.

questions.explanation: "where" thay cho nơi chốn; "be born" ở quá khứ là "was born"; "grew up" song song quá khứ.

questions.question: This / most / beautiful / beach / I / ever / visit.

options.A: This is the most beautiful beach I had ever visited.
options.B: This is most beautiful beach I have ever visited.
options.C: This is the more beautiful beach I have ever visited.
options.D: This is the most beautiful beach I have ever visited.

questions.explanation: So sánh nhất "the most + adj"; đi với "ever" và mốc hiện tại (This is) → hiện tại hoàn thành.

questions.question: Students / not / allow / use / phones / during / exam.

options.A: Students are not allow to use phones during the exam.
options.B: Students are not allowed using phones during the exam.
options.C: Students do not allow to use phones during the exam.
options.D: Students are not allowed to use phones during the exam.

questions.explanation: be (not) allowed to V: học sinh "không được phép" → bị động.
